about:
# Broker_PlayerMenu

Small LibDataBroker plugins for World of Warcraft Forever (interface 16001). Requires a broker display such as Bazooka to show the plugins. Libraries are included.

The default branch, `forever`, targets WoW Forever. The previous `main` branch is now named `MoP`.

- **LootMethod:** Shows loot method, loot threshold, and the master looter. Hover for available loot controls, group conversion, instance reset, and leaving your group. Group management depends on your leader permissions. Right-click toggles opting out of loot; Shift-click the reset, conversion, or leave controls to use them.
- **PVPToggle:** Shows your PvP flag, desired state, and remaining unflag timer. Type `/pvp` in chat to toggle PvP. Shift-right-click announces an active timer to your instance group, raid, party, or local chat output when solo. Click without Shift to refresh the display.
- **RezOptions:** Offers resurrection acceptance, corpse retrieval when in range, available self-resurrection options, and spirit release. Shows the release countdown while dead.

Solo loot controls also include the legacy "Ghetto Hearth" and "Ghetto Raid" helpers, which attempt an invite followed by leaving or converting the group. Their availability depends on the game's group rules; Shift-click the raid helper.

## [v1.10.0-forever](https://github.com/orionshock/Broker_PlayerMenu/tree/v1.10.0-forever) (2026-11-17)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/orionshock/Broker_PlayerMenu/compare/v1.9...v1.10.0-forever) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/orionshock/Broker_PlayerMenu/releases)

- Release v1.10.0 for the Forever client  
- feat(settings): update Lua diagnostics globals and remove unused entries  
    feat(LDBLootMethod): enhance loot method handling and add personal loot option  
    refactor(ldbPVPToggle): simplify PvP toggle logic and update tooltip instructions  
    docs: add AGENTS.md for WoW addon development guidelines  
    delete: remove RDF\_Monitor.lua as it is no longer needed  
- feat(settings): add LE\_LFG\_CATEGORY\_LFD to Lua diagnostics globals

- feat(LDBLootMethod): enhance master looter display with class color coding  
- feat(LDBLootMethod): add Heroic Scenario and Normal Scenario difficulty options  
- AI Lua Docs  
- ai helping me add in player rez stuff  
- refactor(lootmethod): use MoP enum casing + silence editor diagnostics  
    - Fixed Enum.LootMethod key casing to match MoP Classic (Freeforall, Roundrobin,  
      Needbeforegreed, Masterlooter, Personal). This ensures enum lookups match the  
      in-game table.  
    - Added file-local linter annotations (luacheck globals + diagnostic disable)  
      to suppress undefined-global/undefined-field warnings from the language  
      server for MoP-specific APIs and Enum usage.  
    - Kept runtime behavior unchanged; no API calls or runtime logic were moved to  
      retail C\_* equivalents to preserve MoP Classic compatibility.
